what_agents_may_do: Summarize and cite content published on this site, with sources.
Route inquiries to a human steward (via the contact above).
Draft material for a human to review, correct, and decide on.
what_agents_may_not_do: Present an agent draft or proposal as a human decision.
Sign any legal document, contract, or filing.
Represent WAVE to regulators, banks, or the public as a decision-maker.
Claim the GPU model, the open-source engine, or wave@ delivery as live — all three are unverified or not yet live (see llms.txt).
